ns2:course.label: Design Workshop G-I
ns2:course.description: Graduate project design at various scales utilizing problems of a wide range of complexity and subject matter; rural, community, and urban problems, housing, recreation, and natural areas; and emphasizes problem analysis and generation of innovative design alternatives. The student selects from several sections depending on specific interests. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: LA 433/434 or consent of instructor.
